id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

number.description: A unique bus identification number (positive integer).

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations. This field should not be confused with the ISOLATED enum value.

bustype.description: Power flow classification of this bus. It does not by itself say which bus voltage is held; the regulating devices and the bus `voltage_setpoint` say that.

angle.description: Solved voltage angle from the last power flow, or the start value for the next solve. Units: rad.

magnitude.description: Solved voltage magnitude from the last power flow, or the start value for the next solve, as a multiple of `base_voltage`. This is a result, not a control target; the target is `voltage_setpoint`. Units: pu.

voltage_setpoint.description: Scheduled voltage magnitude for this bus, as a multiple of `base_voltage`. It is the target of every device that regulates this bus, at the bus or from a remote terminal. The devices that regulate this bus hold it at this value unless a droop or a reactive power limit prevents it. `null` when no device regulates this bus. Units: pu.

voltage_limits.description: Limits on the voltage variation as multiples of `base_voltage`. Units: pu.

area.description: ID of the area containing the bus.

load_zone.description: ID of the load zone containing the bus.
